description.value:
Impure World Reincarnation. A forbidden kinjutsu. You bind the soul of a deceased creature into a living vessel (a willing or unwilling humanoid), resurrecting them in a body that mimics their living self.

Requirements DNA or a personal effect of the deceased; one willing or unwilling humanoid as the vessel (vessel is consumed); 1 hour of uninterrupted ritual.

The resurrected creature uses the deceased's full original stat block (treat as an NPC of their original level) and is bound to obey you absolutely as long as a control tag (paper seal) remains in their forehead. Removing the tag, sustained injury beyond their original death threshold, or you yourself losing consciousness for more than 1 minute breaks the bond — freed Edo creatures retain their full chakra and can break out of your control entirely.

You can sustain up to (your spellcasting modifier) Edo summons at once. Each one provides a permanent -1 status penalty to your Will saves while sustained.

This is the kinjutsu Orochimaru and later Kabuto used to drag every major dead shinobi back into the Fourth Great War. Use with maximum table caution.
